description: ECMAScript builtin glue — `initialize_datamodel` setdefault-binds `false`/`true`/`null`/`undefined` into the user namespace so bare-name literals in `<cond>` / `<assign expr>` resolve to the standard ECMAScript values instead of raising `NameError`. Author `<data>` declarations still win (setdefault, not assignment). Lifts the most common pytest NameError class without changing the generated SM surface elsewhere.
